How we work

A clear path from question to system.

The work begins with the decision a business needs to make. Research, design, implementation, and evaluation follow that question.

The working sequence

Seven connected decisions.

The depth and pace of each step are agreed for the engagement. This sequence describes the logic, not a fixed package or timeline.

01

Frame the question

Establish the business context, intended audience, constraints, and the decision the project must support.

02

Investigate

Examine the existing brand, product, experience, and available evidence. Research methods depend on the brief.

03

Set direction

Agree on priorities and principles before selecting a visual or product direction.

04

Develop the system

Create and refine the identity, product, digital experience, or combination required by the work.

05

Support implementation

Prepare useful specifications and stay close to how the work is made or shipped.

06

Review what happened

Evaluate the result against the goals and evidence agreed at the start.

07

Evolve deliberately

Maintain and extend the system when the business, product, or audience changes.

Working together

The brief shapes the scope.

A first conversation should clarify the problem, the people involved, the constraints, and what a useful next decision looks like. From there, HS108 can recommend a focused project, a discovery engagement, or ongoing support.
